messages.subject: bivariate outcome
parts:
Good morning everybody, 

I am trying to fit a mediation analysis in lavaan, with "asm10" as  bivariate outcome (yes/no ). All the other variables are continous. 

My syntax is:

myData$asm10c=ordered(myData$asm10c)
myModel <- "asm10c ~ fev.2+agec
                    fev.2 ~ msex"
fit.path <- sem(model = myModel, data = myData, debug=F)

When I run the "fit" function, I get the following error message: 
Error in muthen1984(Data = X[[g]], ov.names = ov.names[[g]], ov.types = ov.types,  :  unknown ov.types:matrix


the same happens if I add the ordered states in the sem formula. 

Could you help me with that? is there something missing in my model? 

Thanks a lot, 

Marta
